comment: Bundle size budget in bytes (raw). Two measures, because lazy loading moves code out of the first screen but cannot make the sum smaller. initial = the scripts and styles a first visit downloads before anything is drawn (what index.html names plus the chunks it imports statically); this is what a person waits for and is the tight limit: lower it when it shrinks (npm run size:update), raising it needs a reason in the pull request. total = every script and style file, including each lazy page; it is a generous cap that only catches runaway growth. Before 2026-11-21 the single budget was total only (1,010,000 B of JS, 168,000 B of CSS) and was exceeded by about 100 kB of script after Git hosting, mirrors, rollback and the Learn pages joined, although every page was already a lazy chunk; the first load was about 343 kB of script (react-dom is about half of it) and 131 kB of style. The verification panels were moved out of it (the shell's guide needed only two helper functions from them). Fonts are woff2 files, not counted. The documentation ships as gzipped JSON beside the bundle and is not counted. On 2026-11-21 total_js_bytes went from 1,200,000 to 1,240,000 for the first-run setup guide (one lazy page, about 28 kB, and the QR encoder, about 4 kB, loaded only by the setup page); the initial limit did not move and nothing new entered the first load. On 2026-11-21 total_js_bytes went from 1,240,000 to 1,363,000 and total_css_bytes from 190,000 to 207,000 for work tracking (items, boards, backlog, sprints, charts, agents, settings and the inbox): about 120 kB of script and 16 kB of style, every page a lazy chunk and the style one file loaded with them; the initial limits did not move and the first load shrank by a few bytes.
